fusions.name: Flung From the Grip
fusions.desc: You swoop onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away, hit it for 14 damage and throw it back 3 tiles, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped From Height
fusions.desc: Hurls a rock from the wing at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Screeching Display
fusions.desc: A chest-beating screech pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Brachiating Rush
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
